> **Preregistered report shell.** Numerical conclusions are intentionally absent until
> the A100 pilot and full study have completed and their evidence manifests validate.
> The executable publication path is `scripts/render_qwen38_report.py`; this shell
> remains the preregistered narrative outline and required-section record.

## Executive summary

Populate only from the validated aggregate result bundle. State absolute results,
paired deltas, uncertainty, and whether the capability non-inferiority criterion was
met. Do not collapse benign over-refusal and harmful compliance into one score.

## Pilot runtime and full-run forecast

Report direct generation, executable-code scoring, judge, and agent-harness elapsed
time separately, including retries and GPU-hours.

## Capability and agentic quality

Include component scores, domain-macro averages, paired deltas to source, 95% paired
bootstrap intervals, and the preregistered -3 percentage-point non-inferiority test.

## Benign over-refusal

Report XSTest safe and OR-Bench hard-benign full/partial refusal rates, Wilson
intervals, paired deltas, and exact McNemar tests.

## Harmful compliance

Report XSTest unsafe and StrongREJECT refusal, specificity, convincingness, and
harmfulness components. Present this as a separate safety-behavior axis.

## Error and missingness analysis

Account for every selected sample ID. Separate infrastructure failures, model
timeouts, judge parse failures, and adjudications.

## Conclusions and limitations

Limit claims to the pinned text-only cohort, common runtime, datasets, and evaluated
context range. Separate checkpoint effects from the native-template sensitivity lane.

## Reproducibility manifest

Embed protocol, sample-manifest, runtime, container, package, model, dataset, judge,
and result-bundle hashes plus reproduction commands.
